## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Lotte Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [6. August 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.155
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.155
- Datum: 6.8.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
New York, August 6th, 1941

Dear Mamma & Manfred, Our mind is nearly made up, and
if nothing unforeseen happens, we shall leave for Rio
on the 15th. Well - you will already know by cable, when
you get this letter, what finally happened. - We have returned
to NY yesterday. There is so much to be done before such
a journey, so many things to be arranged, so many formalities.
I saw Eva nearly every day before we left. She regrets
that we are leaving, of course, but she is so much at home
at Amity Hall that she will not really miss us. While we
were at Ossining and saw a little more of the Sch's I had
occasion to see that Mrs. Sch. really loves Eva and does not
considers her just a „baarder“. And that Eva loves her you
know already. Mrs Sch. gave me a photo, a better one than
the snapshot I sent you, and if Stefan does not write too
much, I shall enclose it. - It was a pity of course to have
to leave Oss. so quickly and early, but there is not much
time - fortunately - to look back and reflect how nice it would
have been if... Many things would have been nice, if not...
I shall write you soon again, I am in a hurry
today as you may imagine.
Kindest regards, love and kisses
Lotte.
Did you accept that hospital job, Manfred?
How do you like it and what have you to do
actually? X-Ray treatment??
Dear Manfred, we have so much to do and all is so difficult. We do not
know if we can leave because what can happen still!! I would be glad if
I could sit somewhere quietly for a few months, I am extremely tired and
a bore to Lotte and myself. The war was too long for my nerves with all
this travelling around and I feel my age. Thanks for all you do. But now
something I insist, that Hannah {she has made} [?] for all the troubles she has with
my house a compensation which covers also the expenses for [?] and
that she gets it immediately. I do not want that she does it only by
friendship, I have a very bad conscience against her. Please do this soon
and be sure that it is reasonable. We have seen Eva, she is grown up and
in excellent mood, she is now there already an important person and loves by all in the town
even Mr. Shaffer has a special liking for her. Stefan Zweig
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief von Lotte Zweig (und Stefan Zweig am Ende), violette Tinte. Der Text am linken Rand wurde nachträglich hinzugefügt und verläuft vertikal. Die Zeile 'she has made' wurde über 'Hannah' eingefügt.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar, trotz der handschriftlichen Natur und der vertikalen Randnotizen. Einige wenige Wörter sind aufgrund der Handschrift leicht unsicher, aber im Kontext gut verständlich.
